pages.title: Nebula Lens
pages.text: Anti-magic and dodge remnant. Dodges hits with $(thing)Reactive Blink$(), then hits back harder. Dropped by the Warden.

pages.title: Dormant and Latent
pages.text: $(l)Dormant$(): Much less magic damage. No ender pearl damage. Water makes you unstable.$(br2)$(l)Latent$(): Even less magic damage. Sometimes teleports you out of physical attacks. Rain and water can cause short random teleports.

pages.title: Awakened, Ascended, Transcendent, Apex
pages.text: $(l)Awakened$(): Unlocks $(thing)Reactive Blink$(): after dodging a hit, your next hit is empowered.$(br2)$(l)Ascended$(): Stronger empowered hits. Water teleports no longer hurt you.$(br2)$(l)Transcendent$(): Blinks happen more often and can give a short speed boost.$(br2)$(l)Apex$(): Strongest magic resistance and blink counterattacks.
